2083      async def _complete_run(
 2084          self,
 2085          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
 2086          run_id: UUID,
 2087          *,
 2088          status: str,
 2089          final_output: str | None,
 2090          failure_code: str | None,
 2091          model_step_count: int,
 2092          tool_call_count: int,
 2093          usage_records: list[dict[str, Any]],
 2094          turn_transcript: list[Any] | None = None,
 2095          turn_evidence_registry: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
 2096          pending_finish: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
 2097      ) -> AgentRunResult:
 2098          async with self.session_factory() as session:
 2099              run = await session.scalar(
 2100                  select(AgentRun)
 2101                  .where(AgentRun.workspace_id == UUID(context.workspace_id), AgentRun.id == run_id)
 2102                  .with_for_update()
 2103              )
 2104              if run is None:
 2105                  raise AgentHubError("AGENT_RUN_NOT_FOUND", "The agent run was not found.", 404)
 2106              effective_status = status
 2107              effective_output = final_output
 2108              effective_failure = failure_code
 2109              claim = await session.scalar(
 2110                  select(Approval.id)
 2111                  .where(
 2112                      Approval.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
 2113                      Approval.run_id == run.id,
 2114                      Approval.execution_status.in_({"CLAIMED", "UNKNOWN_OUTCOME"}),
 2115                  )
 2116                  .limit(1)
 2117              )
 2118              uncertain = (
 2119                  status == "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
 2120                  or _is_uncertain_action_failure(failure_code)
 2121                  or isinstance(claim, UUID)
 2122              )
 2123              budget_unknown = False
 2124              if getattr(self, "model_attempt_budget_factory", None) is not None:
 2125                  budget_unknown = (
 2126                      await session.scalar(
 2127                          select(RunBudgetAttempt.id)
 2128                          .where(
 2129                              RunBudgetAttempt.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
 2130                              RunBudgetAttempt.run_id == run.id,
 2131                              RunBudgetAttempt.attempt_kind.in_(("MAIN_MODEL", "RETRY", "FALLBACK")),
 2132                              RunBudgetAttempt.status == "UNKNOWN_OUTCOME",
 2133                          )
 2134                          .limit(1)
 2135                      )
 2136                  ) is not None
 2137              if uncertain:
 2138                  effective_status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
 2139                  effective_output = None
 2140                  effective_failure = failure_code or "ACTION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
 2141              elif budget_unknown:
 2142                  # Financial uncertainty does not invalidate a returned answer,
 2143                  # but the Run remains visible for reconciliation.
 2144                  effective_status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
 2145                  effective_failure = "RUN_BUDGET_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
 2146              elif run.status in {"CANCELLED", "NEEDS_ATTENTION"}:
 2147                  effective_status = run.status
 2148                  effective_output = run.final_output
 2149                  effective_failure = run.failure_code
 2150              elif run.status == "CANCEL_REQUESTED":
 2151                  if status == "NEEDS_ATTENTION" or _is_uncertain_action_failure(failure_code):
 2152                      effective_status = "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
 2153                      effective_output = None
 2154                      effective_failure = failure_code or "ACTION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED"
 2155                  else:
 2156                      effective_status = "CANCELLED"
 2157                      effective_output = None
 2158                      effective_failure = None
 2159              run.status = effective_status
 2160              run.event_log_complete = False
 2161              run.resume_pending = False
 2162              run.waiting_approval_id = None
 2163              run.final_output = effective_output
 2164              run.failure_code = effective_failure
 2165              previous_rounds = getattr(run, "model_step_count", 0) or 0
 2166              run.model_step_count = max(model_step_count, previous_rounds)
 2167              run.tool_call_count = max(tool_call_count, getattr(run, "tool_call_count", 0) or 0)
 2168              if (
 2169                  effective_status == "SUCCEEDED"
 2170                  and turn_transcript is not None
 2171                  and run.thread_turn_id
 2172              ):
 2173                  try:
 2174                      transcript = build_turn_transcript(
 2175                          # asyncpg may return UUID subclasses; normalize at the
 2176                          # persistence boundary to the transcript's exact type.
 2177                          run_id=UUID(str(run.id)),
 2178                          turn_id=UUID(str(run.thread_turn_id)),
 2179                          messages=turn_transcript,
 2180                      )
 2181                      if (
 2182                          transcript.messages[0].content != run.input_text
 2183                          or transcript.messages[-1].content != effective_output
 2184                          or sum(len(message.tool_calls) for message in transcript.messages)
 2185                          != run.tool_call_count
 2186                      ):
 2187                          raise ValueError("turn transcript does not match run")
 2188                      payload = transcript.to_payload()
 2189                  except (TypeError, ValueError):
 2190                      # The business outcome is already determined; leave the
 2191                      # source unavailable rather than inventing a transcript.
 2192                      logger.warning("thread_history_transcript_unavailable")
 2193                  else:
 2194                      if (
 2195                          run.thread_history_transcript is not None
 2196                          and run.thread_history_transcript != payload
 2197                      ):
 2198                          raise AgentHubError(
 2199                              "AGENT_HISTORY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID",
 2200                              "The completed turn transcript changed.",
 2201                              409,
 2202                          )
 2203                      run.thread_history_transcript = payload
 2204                      try:
 2205                          evidence = visible_evidence_registry(
 2206                              transcript.messages, turn_evidence_registry or {}
 2207                          )
 2208                          if (
 2209                              len(
 2210                                  json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode(
 2211                                      "utf-8"
 2212                                  )
 2213                              )
 2214                              > MAX_ENCODED_BYTES
 2215                          ):
 2216                              raise ValueError("thread evidence exceeds the storage bound")
 2217                      except (AgentHubError, TypeError, ValueError):
 2218                          logger.warning("thread_history_evidence_unavailable")
 2219                      else:
 2220                          if (
 2221                              run.thread_history_evidence_registry is not None
 2222                              and run.thread_history_evidence_registry != evidence
 2223                          ):
 2224                              raise AgentHubError(
 2225                                  "AGENT_HISTORY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID",
 2226                                  "The completed turn evidence changed.",
 2227                                  409,
 2228                              )
 2229                          run.thread_history_evidence_registry = evidence
 2230              # Abort before restoring the checkpoint has no new usage evidence;
 2231              # it must not erase spend already persisted by an earlier segment.
 2232              if usage_records or previous_rounds == 0:
 2233                  for key, value in _aggregate_usage(usage_records).items():
 2234                      setattr(run, key, value)
 2235              existing_finish = (
 2236                  await session.scalar(
 2237                      select(RunStep)
 2238                      .where(
 2239                          RunStep.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
 2240                          RunStep.agent_run_id == run.id,
 2241                          RunStep.kind == "FINISH",
 2242                      )
 2243                      .order_by(RunStep.sequence_number)
 2244                      .limit(1)
 2245                  )
 2246                  if pending_finish is not None
 2247                  else None
 2248              )
 2249              if pending_finish is not None and existing_finish is None:
 2250                  latest_sequence = await session.scalar(
 2251                      select(func.max(RunStep.sequence_number)).where(
 2252                          RunStep.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
 2253                          RunStep.agent_run_id == run.id,
 2254                      )
 2255                  )
 2256                  safe_metadata = pending_finish.get("safe_metadata")
 2257                  if not isinstance(safe_metadata, Mapping):
 2258                      safe_metadata = {}
 2259                  session.add(
 2260                      RunStep(
 2261                          workspace_id=run.workspace_id,
 2262                          agent_run_id=run.id,

1  # 前端文字排版修正报告
    2  
    3  日期：2026-10-03。基线 `e064c36`（M-I5 已验收并推送）。本轮使用本机隔离数据库与合成内容，未调用付费模型。最终代码对应本报告所在提交。
    4  
    5  ## 修复的问题
    6  
    7  | 问题与复现 | 原因 | 修正 |
    8  | --- | --- | --- |
    9  | 1280px 客服/应用工作台右侧内容仅 240px，右边大幅空白 | 两列断点仅给 research artifacts 设置跨列，应用的 app-pane-stack 未覆盖 | 复用现有断点，三种应用 stack 在中等宽度跨两列，手机恢复单列 |
   10  | 手机工作区选择器被挤成小框，与账户区域相邻挤压 | 顶栏所有控件共用一行，选择器空间低于自身内边距 | ≤480px 工作区选择器独占第二行；工作区/组织名称有限宽省略，完整名称仍由原控件提供 |
   11  | 手机 Dashboard 首登引导提示逐字换行 | 引导主标题 nowrap 占用大部分宽度，说明只剩窄列 | ≤640px stat-row 单列，主标题允许换行，值及说明左对齐 |
   12  | 长 Agent 名称把面包屑撑到约 1300px | 面包屑 flex 子项默认最小内容宽度且连续字符串不换行 | 限制子项宽度，min-width:0，允许连续字符串换行 |
   13  | 加载长接管记录后，卡片内部被撑到约 2000px；滚动容器掩盖了页面级溢出 | 内部 grid 自动列按长字符串的内容宽度扩张 | pane-body/artifact-card 使用 minmax(0,1fr)，子项和字段可收缩，长事项与引用允许换行 |
   14  
   15  同时加固共享标题/说明的长字符串换行、表单控件最小宽度、按钮换行与最大宽度、panel actions 折行、手机键值布局，以及列表文本子项最小宽度。沿用既有令牌和样式文件，没有新 CSS 依赖或 i18n 键。
   16  
   17  ## 浏览器验证
   18  
   19  使用 computer-use/CUA 操作真实本机页面，API 经项目已有同源代理访问隔离数据库。
   20  
   21  - 11 个核心页面 × 6 个宽度（360/390/768/1024/1280/1440）× 中英文 = **132** 个组合。
   22  - 12 个扩展页面 × 3 个宽度（360/768/1280）× 中英文 = **72** 个组合。
   23  - Dashboard、Agent 详情、Support 详情 × 4 个边界宽度（320/481/901/1281）× 中英文 = **24** 个组合。
   24  - 合计 **228** 个组合，页面/元素越界、顶栏按钮碰撞及可见文本矩形交叠检查均通过。
   25  
   26  核心页面：Dashboard、Agents、Knowledge、Tools、Runs、Approvals、Evaluations、Settings、Support 详情、Agent 详情、Run 详情。扩展页面：Research、Incidents、Analytics、Support 入口、Retrieval Playground、Run Compare、模型设置、Datasets、Experiments、Release Gates、Pricing、MCP Import。
   27  
   28  Support 的 12 个主矩阵组合显式等待长未解决事项加载后重新测量，覆盖长问题、客户/工单连续 ID、URL、长关闭原因、连续英文未解决项，以及 NEEDS_ATTENTION/UNKNOWN_OUTCOME 对话。实际 UI 再次完成开启→接手→关闭，并保留两条未解决事项。没有触发远端工具或模型。
   29  
   30  另检查手机端展开的检索参数、账户菜单及长接管卡片截图。菜单有不透明浮层遮盖下层内容，属于正常浮层；人工核实，不将跨层遮盖判成文字交叠。
   31  
   32  ## 自动检查与证据
   33  
   34  - [主矩阵](evidence/layout-20261003/matrix.json)、[边界矩阵](evidence/layout-20261003/edges.json) 保存逐页测量。
   35  - `scripts/layout_audit.mjs` 为可复用的只读 DOM 几何检查器；排除已裁剪文字和关闭的 details 内容，避免省略号/折叠区误报。
   36  - `node scripts/check_layout_report.cjs` 验证覆盖数、失败项及证据/样式 SHA-256；包含 4 类注入坏记录的拒绝检查，退出 0。样式变化会要求重做证据，不能沿用旧通过记录。
   37  - `node scripts/test_web_review.cjs`：12 组前端行为回归通过，退出 0。
   38  - `tsc --noEmit`：退出 0。
   39  - 最终 `next build`：退出 0；本机完整日志 `.scratch/mi34-20261002/layout-build-final-job/`。
   40  - `git diff --check`：退出 0。本轮只改 CSS/检查脚本/文档；后端复用上一轮 1232 通过、4 跳过结果，没有重复运行不受影响的后端套件。
   41  
   42  ### 视觉对照
   43  
   44  手机顶栏修复前：
   45  
   46  ![修复前](evidence/layout-20261003/support-mobile-before.png)
   47  
   48  长接管事项修复后：
   49  
   50  ![修复后](evidence/layout-20261003/handoff-card-mobile-after.png)
   51  
   52  另保存长名称复现、长卡片修复前后及展开检索参数的截图于同目录。
   53  
   54  ## 范围与限制
   55  
   56  这些结果验证本机浏览器与所列视口/样本，不代表全部浏览器、所有弹窗或任意数据的布局保证。Knowledge、Approvals、评测子页、MCP 等主要覆盖空列表与初始表单；已加载长内容重点覆盖 Agent/Run/Support。没有伪造审批/远端 MCP 数据。
   57  
   58  DOM 矩形检测是回归辅助：文本矩形无法完全表示字形和浮层遮挡；滚动表格、SVG 图表、pre 代码块不纳入普通页面越界判定，仍保留各自滚动行为。初轮记录中的省略号及折叠区误报已核实并修正检测器；最终矩阵采用修正后的可见性规则。本轮不宣称补齐旧收尾清单里的其他独立特性。

1  """Exercise the production Wiki API with the current raw RAG implementation."""
    2  
    3  from __future__ import annotations
    4  
    5  import os
    6  from types import SimpleNamespace
    7  from uuid import UUID
    8  
    9  import httpx
   10  import pytest
   11  import pytest_asyncio
   12  from qdrant_client import QdrantClient
   13  from sqlalchemy import select
   14  
   15  from apps.api.app import create_app
   16  from apps.api.dependencies import get_db_session
   17  from apps.api.knowledge_dependencies import get_workspace_context
   18  from packages.core.config.settings import Settings
   19  from packages.core.database import create_database
   20  from packages.knowledge.adapters.fakes import (
   21      DeterministicFakeDenseEmbedder,
   22      DeterministicFakeReranker,
   23      DeterministicFakeSparseEncoder,
   24  )
   25  from packages.knowledge.adapters.qdrant import QdrantVectorIndex
   26  from packages.knowledge.contracts import VectorRecord
   27  from packages.knowledge.models import DocumentChunk
   28  from packages.knowledge.point_ids import deterministic_point_id
   29  from packages.wiki.service import WikiService, claim_job, execute_job
   30  from tests.support.wiki import FakeCompiler, add_source, seed_wiki
   31  
   32  TEST_DATABASE_URL = os.environ.get("AGENTHUB_TEST_DATABASE_URL", "").strip()
   33  pytestmark = [
   34      pytest.mark.integration,
   35      pytest.mark.skipif(not TEST_DATABASE_URL, reason="Set AGENTHUB_TEST_DATABASE_URL."),
   36  ]
   37  
   38  
   39  @pytest_asyncio.fixture
   40  async def db_factory():
   41      url = TEST_DATABASE_URL.replace("postgresql://", "postgresql+asyncpg://", 1)
   42      engine, factory = create_database(url)
   43      try:
   44          yield factory
   45      finally:
   46          await engine.dispose()
   47  
   48  
   49  @pytest.mark.asyncio
   50  async def test_api_modes_compose_current_rag_with_frozen_wiki_and_scope(
   51      db_factory, monkeypatch
   52  ) -> None:
   53      context, kb_id, profile_id, revisions = await seed_wiki(db_factory)
   54      outsider, _, _, outsider_revisions = await seed_wiki(db_factory)
   55      service = WikiService()
   56      async with db_factory() as session:
   57          compilation = await service.request(session, context, kb_id, profile_id)
   58      async with db_factory() as session:
   59          claim = await claim_job(session, compilation.id)
   60      assert claim is not None
   61      assert (
   62          await execute_job(db_factory, context, claim.id, claim.lease_token, FakeCompiler())
   63          == "ready"
   64      )
   65      async with db_factory() as session:
   66          published = await service.publish(session, context, kb_id, compilation.id)
   67  
   68      # This source is indexed but must never enter the already frozen publication.
   69      later = await add_source(db_factory, context, kb_id, "Retention period is 99 years.")
   70      async with db_factory() as session:
   71          chunks = list(
   72              await session.scalars(
   73                  select(DocumentChunk).where(
   74                      DocumentChunk.document_revision_id.in_(
   75                          [*revisions, *outsider_revisions, later.id]
   76                      )
   77                  )
   78              )
   79          )
   80      originals = {chunk.chunk_id: chunk for chunk in chunks}
   81      dense = DeterministicFakeDenseEmbedder(dimension=4)
   82      sparse = DeterministicFakeSparseEncoder()
   83      index = QdrantVectorIndex(
   84          url=":memory:",
   85          collection_name="wiki-rag-integration",
   86          dense_vector_size=4,
   87          client=QdrantClient(":memory:"),
   88      )
   89      index.ensure_collection()
   90      index.upsert(
   91          [
   92              VectorRecord(
   93                  point_id=deterministic_point_id(chunk.chunk_id),
   94                  chunk_id=chunk.chunk_id,
   95                  dense=dense.embed_query(chunk.text),
   96                  sparse=sparse.encode_query(chunk.text),
   97                  payload={
   98                      "chunk_id": chunk.chunk_id,
   99                      "workspace_id": str(chunk.workspace_id),
  100                      "knowledge_base_id": str(chunk.knowledge_base_id),
  101                      "document_revision_id": str(chunk.document_revision_id),
  102                  },
  103              )
  104              for chunk in chunks
  105          ]
  106      )
  107      component_requests = []
  108  
  109      async def components(request):
  110          component_requests.append(request.url.path)
  111          return SimpleNamespace(
  112              dense=dense, sparse=sparse, reranker=DeterministicFakeReranker(), index=index
  113          )
  114  
  115      # Replace only provider initialization; API -> HybridKnowledgeRetriever ->
  116      # scoped SQL/Qdrant -> rerank -> Wiki evidence validation runs unchanged.
  117      monkeypatch.setattr("apps.api.routes.wiki.get_retrieval_components", components)
  118      settings = Settings(testing=True, database_url=TEST_DATABASE_URL)
  119      app = create_app(settings)
  120      active_context = context
  121  
  122      async def context_dependency():
  123          return active_context
  124  
  125      async def database_dependency():
  126          async with db_factory() as session:
  127              yield session
  128  
  129      app.dependency_overrides[get_workspace_context] = context_dependency
  130      app.dependency_overrides[get_db_session] = database_dependency
  131      path = (
  132          f"/api/v1/workspaces/{context.workspace_id}/knowledge-bases/"
  133          f"{kb_id}/wiki/compilations/{published.id}/query"
  134      )
  135      body = {
  136          "source_snapshot_id": str(published.source_snapshot_id),
  137          "query": "retention period",
  138          "intent": "synthesis",
  139          "require_current": False,
  140      }
  141      try:
  142          async with httpx.AsyncClient(
  143              transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
  144          ) as client:
  145              for mode in ("WIKI", "RAG", "HYBRID"):
  146                  response = await client.post(path, json={**body, "mode": mode})
  147                  assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
  148                  result = response.json()
  149                  assert result["route"] == mode
  150                  assert result["binding"]["compilation_hash"] == published.content_hash
  151                  assert result["binding"]["source_snapshot_id"] == str(published.source_snapshot_id)
  152                  assert result["binding"]["source_snapshot_hash"] == published.source_snapshot_hash
  153                  assert result["binding"]["validated"] is True
  154                  raw = [e for e in result["evidence"] if e["source"] == "raw_retrieval"]
  155                  if mode == "WIKI":
  156                      assert not component_requests and not raw
  157                      assert result["wiki_pages"]
  158                  else:
  159                      assert len(raw) == 2
  160                      assert not result["supplemental_required"]
  161                  if mode == "HYBRID":
  162                      assert result["wiki_pages"] and result["conflicts"]
  163                      assert result["answer"] == (
  164                          "Conflicting evidence prevents a safe extractive answer."
  165                      )
  166                  for evidence in result["evidence"]:
  167                      chunk = originals[evidence["chunk_id"]]
  168                      assert chunk.workspace_id == UUID(context.workspace_id)
  169                      assert chunk.knowledge_base_id == kb_id
  170                      assert chunk.document_revision_id in revisions
  171                      assert evidence["document_revision_id"] == str(chunk.document_revision_id)
  172                      assert evidence["locator"] == chunk.locator
  173                      assert evidence["quote"] in chunk.text
  174              assert len(component_requests) == 2
  175  
  176              # Cross-tenant binding validation fails before raw providers are loaded.
  177              active_context = outsider
  178              foreign = await client.post(path, json={**body, "mode": "HYBRID"})
  179              assert foreign.status_code == 404
  180              assert len(component_requests) == 2

415      async def _load_and_validate_case_set(
  416          self,
  417          session: AsyncSession,
  418          workspace_id: UUID,
  419          run: EvaluationExperimentRun,
  420          experiment: EvaluationExperiment,
  421      ) -> list[tuple[Any, Any, Any]]:
  422          variants = list(
  423              await session.scalars(
  424                  select(EvaluationExperimentVariant).where(
  425                      EvaluationExperimentVariant.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  426                      EvaluationExperimentVariant.experiment_id == experiment.id,
  427                  )
  428              )
  429          )
  430          items = list(
  431              await session.scalars(
  432                  select(EvaluationDatasetItem).where(
  433                      EvaluationDatasetItem.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  434                      EvaluationDatasetItem.dataset_version_id == experiment.dataset_version_id,
  435                      EvaluationDatasetItem.split == experiment.split,
  436                  )
  437              )
  438          )
  439          expected = {
  440              (variant.id, item.id, repetition)
  441              for variant in variants
  442              for item in items
  443              for repetition in range(run.repetitions)
  444          }
  445          rows = await self._case_rows(session, workspace_id, run.id)
  446          if any(case.status not in _TERMINAL_CASES for case, _, _ in rows):
  447              raise AgentHubError(
  448                  "EVALUATION_METRICS_RUN_NOT_TERMINAL",
  449                  "All case results must be terminal before metrics materialization.",
  450                  409,
  451              )
  452          actual = {
  453              (case.experiment_variant_id, case.dataset_item_id, case.repetition_index)
  454              for case, _, _ in rows
  455          }
  456          if actual != expected or len(rows) != len(actual):
  457              raise AgentHubError(
  458                  "EVALUATION_CASE_SET_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
  459                  "Persisted case results do not match the frozen execution plan.",
  460                  409,
  461              )
  462          return rows
